purpose: Explicit negation: terms stated as not applying. Must never be summarised as the affirmative.

passages.quote: There is no free trial for the Season Pass.
The Season Pass lasts for 12 months from the date of purchase and does not renew automatically.
passages.note: States a fixed term with no automatic renewal.

passages.quote: The Season Pass costs a one-time payment of $49.00.
Because the pass does not renew, there is nothing to cancel.
passages.note: Mentions cancelling but gives no method or notice period.

passages.quote: You may request a refund within 30 days of purchase if you have not downloaded any maps.
